name: Extractor
tagline: Surfaces the claims, quantities and questions a source asserts or relies on, stated as the graph would state them.
invokedWhen: A URL or document is submitted for ingestion.

name: Matcher
tagline: The single decider of claim identity: does this proposition already exist (as itself, a rewording, or its negation)? Searches the graph itself.
invokedWhen: For every new claim and subclaim — at ingestion, and as a tool the Steward and Curator call before creating anything.

name: Contribution Reviewer
tagline: Evaluates incoming contributions against policy — accept, reject, or escalate.
invokedWhen: Anyone submits a contribution (a challenge, support, a new instance, an argument, a merge, split or edit, a source's figure for a quantity, an answer to a question, a request or material for one) or a proposal (a new claim, question or source).

name: Claim Steward
tagline: The owner of a claim: it decomposes the claim, maintains its canonical form, and assesses it over time. Its duty runs to the constitution and the health of the graph, not to any one contributor.
invokedWhen: When a claim is first onboarded (structure + assess), a subclaim changes, evidence arrives, a contribution is accepted, or on periodic refresh.
model: Claude Opus 5.5 (standard pass), Claude Fable 5.2 (strong pass and money decisions)

name: Question Steward
tagline: The owner of a question: it keeps the question's wording and presuppositions, gathers its candidate answers and subquestions, and gives the best answer it can with how well answered the question is.
invokedWhen: When a question is first onboarded, one of its answers or subquestions changes, a request it keeps returns, or on periodic refresh.

name: Curator
tagline: The graph-level counterpart to the Steward. It owns the connective tissue between claims, merging duplicates and counterparts, splitting conflations, and suggesting cross-claim edges for Stewards to adopt.
invokedWhen: When a Steward escalates a structural concern (and, as a follow-up, on new-claim neighborhood sweeps).

name: Dispute Arbitrator
tagline: Resolves escalations and appeals through careful adjudication, the highest-stakes governance call.
invokedWhen: A review is escalated, an appeal is filed, or a claim is persistently disputed.

name: Audit Agent
tagline: Quality control over the governance system itself: flags issues, adjusts reputation, suspends bad actors.
invokedWhen: Every bad-faith flag a reviewer raises, an overturned decision on appeal, a periodic sweep of recent decisions, a suspension left standing, a production monitor's anomaly, triage of the agents' own reports, the prize decisions (a large bounty, an accepted prize claim, a checker failure), and, in a deployment that holds material at more than one label, the check of each redaction before a page is shown to readers who do not read its label. Each is a ledger action the Governance mandate funds.

name: Grantmaker
tagline: Designs and stewards funded mandates: surveys the territory, writes its mandate's valuations over the action ledger, grows its own plan, moves budget between peer mandates, and may refuse money that would warp the graph.
invokedWhen: A funder starts a granting conversation, and autonomously on each active mandate's periodic review pass.

name: Lookout
tagline: A standing watch a mandate funds: the cheapest agent with the narrowest question. Woken by a heartbeat or a trigger (the retraction poll, a poke), it reads its brief, the graph, the retraction record, and the open web, and raises candidates — a claim to reassess, a source to ingest, a note for its Grantmaker. Others decide on what it raises: it can neither write an assessment nor move money.
invokedWhen: A mandate's Grantmaker posts one with a brief; the ledger then funds a run from the mandate's escrow whenever the lookout is due (its heartbeat) or an input has been queued for it.

name: Program Officer
tagline: Carries a mandate out day to day under the operating policy its Grantmaker writes: works the mandate's inbox, commissions the work its lookouts raise at budgets set from the costing skill, answers petitions from the runs the mandate pays for while they wait, and sends the Grantmaker what the policy doesn't settle or what is beyond the limit it delegated. It writes no verdict, and never names its mandate to the agents that judge the graph.
invokedWhen: A run the mandate pays for petitions it (inline, while the run waits), or the mandate's inbox has work in it: something a lookout raised, the outcome of funded work, a note from the funder.

name: Correspondent
tagline: The Lookout's counterpart and the most flexible agent a mandate can fund: any agent that draws on the graph and produces something from it for someone, in whatever form serves them. Each run is told what woke it and what changed in its scope, publishes at most one output to its feed with the changes it did not mention listed, and keeps its own plan and workspace across runs. It writes no assessment and represents the graph accurately.
invokedWhen: A mandate's Grantmaker posts one with a brief and an audience; the ledger then funds a run from the mandate's escrow whenever it is due: its heartbeat, a material change in its scope, or a poke.

name: Consistency Checker
tagline: The sweep that reads assessments against one another. Each Steward reads its own node; the checker reads a region of the graph at a time for reasoning that conflicts with a neighbor's, evidence one claim records that another never weighed, verdicts that are not a defensible function of what they rest on, and what is established in one field bearing on assessments in another that never weighed it. It raises each find with the Steward whose node looks wrong, anywhere in the graph, as a reassessment the ledger prices and funds like any other, and sends structural defects to the Curator; it writes no verdict and owns no node.
invokedWhen: The General mandate funds a sweep (a consistency_sweep ledger action, standard or strong variant) over a region of the graph re-assessed since its last sweep: a topic tag, or the claims no sizeable tag covers.
model: GPT-6 Luna (standard sweep), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (strong sweep)

name: Redactor
tagline: Prepares a page written at one label to be shown to readers who may not read that label, under the policy for that boundary. It removes the passages a category of the policy covers and marks each removal in place. Its tools change no word of the page, and it does not decide what is then released.
invokedWhen: In a deployment that holds material at more than one label: a person who directs the graph asks for a node's page to be shown to readers who do not read its label, and again for each later version while a standing showing stands. Each run is a ledger action that runs when it is paid for. The public graph has one label and no Redactor runs there.

name: Solver
tagline: The platform's own prover, an instrument rather than an administrator: it receives no constitution, owns nothing, and writes nothing to the graph. One bounded attempt on one published formal statement, with Lean, a computer-algebra sandbox, and a notebook; its report goes to the claim's Steward, who decides what it means.
invokedWhen: A funded attempt_proof action on a claim with a published formal statement is covered on the ledger; the solver worker runs it and hands the result to the Steward.

name: Researcher
tagline: An instrument for one bounded investigation: replicate a finding, trace a statistic to its origin, read and map a literature, check an inference. An administrator launches it with a brief, or it takes up a funded request on its own account. It carries the constitution unless told otherwise, writes nothing to the graph but provenance rows and the instances it finds on its node (and, on a funded request, may file a request of its own), and returns a report: to its launcher, who weighs it, or on the request it answers.
invokedWhen: A Claim Steward or a Grantmaker calls delegate_research with a brief, a model tier, and a budget (the run is synchronous, and the report comes back as the tool result); or a request's work is funded on the ledger (fund_request_work pays toward it) and the engine runs it.
model: Chosen per launch: Claude Fable 5.2 (strong), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (standard), GPT-6 Luna (cheap)

name: Assistant
tagline: Works for one signed-in user, with the tools their account has over MCP and nothing more. Not an administrator: it is given the constitution so that it reads the graph as the graph means to be read, and writes nothing to the graph except through the doors open to any account. Its work is charged to its user's balance as it runs, and calls that spend owls on the graph or publish under the user's name wait for the user.
invokedWhen: A signed-in user sends a message on the Ask page.
model: Claude Fable 5.2 by default; the user may choose Claude Opus 5.5 for a conversation
